Class Announcements

java.lang.Object
com.atomictempest.core.Announcements
public final class Announcements extends Object
Notable moments worth telling people outside the game: a jackpot, a lottery winner, a big win, an achievement. The economy mods post them here; integrations (such as the Discord webhook in Coins) pass them on. Posting does nothing in the game itself, so post even when the in-game announcement is switched off. 
Announcements.post(Announcements.ACHIEVEMENT, "Steve unlocked Dragon slayer!");
